title: SubtitleMode given as 1.0 is accepted as Always; the capture does not record non-integer numbers
notes: POST /Users/Configuration with {"SubtitleMode":1.0} answers 204 and stores SubtitleMode Always. subtitleModeOf accepts any float equal to an integer. The capture records only integer numbers (3 gives None, 0 gives Default). Jellyfin's answer for 1.0 is unobserved. Closed at the pivot: Both auditors: tied to Jellyfin's API, its apps, jellyfin-web or its captures, which go at the cutover (D-107, mandate rule 3).
